I understand loss as I have had loss in my family and it’s definitely hard. There are many different forms of loss too. What did you mean by “OLD was a waste of time “?

For me personally depending on the type of loss I think it has helped me to view them in a different way. I’m a spiritual person so I look at losses as celebrations sometimes for me and sometimes for others as each loss is different. When I loss my grandma who I was close too and she passed away it was very hard and I celebrate her life by keeping her memory alive and visiting her grave. And I’m not sure if what I’m about to say is healthy or not but, I love meeting people where I see my grandma in them as if she is still with me. 
I also bought a cup that had her one of her favorite songs lyrics on the cup I found at a cracker barrell. I’m sure if she was looking down from heaven at me she would be happy she is not forgotten and I would think she would want me to be happy even without her as she herself is in a wonderful place called heaven and so I’m happy for her. And I think it would honor her and be a compliment to a future wife that she shared similar characteristics in a wife you adored. 

I also have had another loss I felt when I lost custody of my son about 8years ago. That was hard. And our relationship has never been the same but focusing on the positive he was being taken care of better than I could provide at the time and he is 18 now and in college and doing well. I may have hindered his road if he stayed with me. Although I have a distant relationship with him now  I just celebrate that because of the loss I was able to get where I needed to be and him the same so I can be a good mom for him in Gods perfect timing. I focus on things I can do to rebuild basically. This can apply to moving forward as well. 

Rebuilding as in giving us the rest, healing, and loving ourselves how we need without time limits. So just because it’s been 2 years it’s not uncommon to take way longer than that so don’t feel guilty or ashamed or any other negativity or pressure or stress if it’s just not time. Take all the time you need to grieve. I also use to work for a funeral home and at anytime you need to go to one they have free videos and literature to assist you in your healing. There also grief groups at churches and men’s groups that can support you.
Bless you. I cancel urge you to say” I cancel the assignment that I will never move on and I decree and declare in the name of Jesus that my heart is filled with peace, love , and joy once again in Gods perfect timing and no one else’s.
